segments.ja465:1.1: Kā tvaṃ suddhehi vatthehi, aghe vehāyasaṃ [vehāsayaṃ (sī. pī.)] ṭhitā;
segments.ja465:1.3: Kena tyāssūni vattanti, kuto taṃ bhayamāgataṃ.
segments.ja465:2.1: Taveva deva vijite, bhaddasāloti maṃ vidū;
segments.ja465:2.3: Saṭṭhi [saṭṭhiṃ (sī. pī.)] vassasahassāni, tiṭṭhato pūjitassa me.
segments.ja465:3.3: Vividhe cāpi pāsāde, na maṃ te accamaññisuṃ;
segments.ja465:3.5: Yatheva maṃ te pūjesuṃ, tatheva tvampi pūjaya.
segments.ja465:4.1: Taṃ ivāhaṃ [tañca ahaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] na passāmi, thūlaṃ kāyena te dumaṃ;
segments.ja465:5.3: Tattha taṃ upanessāmi, ciraṃ te yakkha jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja465:7.1: Agge ca chetvā majjhe ca, pacchā mūlamhi chindatha [mūlañca chindatha (sī.), mūlaṃ vichindatha (pī.)];
segments.ja465:7.3: Evaṃ me chijjamānassa, na dukkhaṃ maraṇaṃ siyā.
segments.ja465:8.3: Tato pacchā siro chinde, taṃ dukkhaṃ maraṇaṃ siyā.
segments.ja465:9.3: Kiṃ hetu kiṃ upādāya, khaṇḍaso chinnamicchasi.
segments.ja465:11.1: Ñātī me sukhasaṃvaddhā, mama passe nivātajā;
segments.ja465:12.3: Hitakāmosi ñātīnaṃ, abhayaṃ samma dammi teti.
